name: venturegenesis
description: Run the whole stack from the repo root.

scripts.dev:backend: node scripts/require-venv.js && cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.setup:backend: python3 -m venv backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -q --upgrade pip && backend/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r backend/requirements-min.txt
